He was previously Director, Technical Accounting and Internal Reporting from 2019 to 2025.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div style="text-indent:36pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Mr. Elliott does not have any family relationships with any director or executive officer of the Corporation, and there are no arrangements or undertakings with any person pursuant to which he was selected as an officer of the Corporation. Exchange Act of 1934.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div style="text-indent:36pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New
